name: Toyo Wharf & Warehouse Co., Ltd.
summary: Toyo Wharf & Warehouse Co., Ltd. is a Tokyo-based company providing logistics throughout Japan. Domestic services cover warehousing, cargo loading and unloading, and transport by vehicle and port facilities, extended by terminal management, logistics property leasing, customs brokerage, ship agency and insurance agency. It also offers international logistics by land, sea and air.
